subject: Re: Quantix - Security evidence & procurement next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@quantix.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya@quantix.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@quantix.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: Post-demo recap & next steps

Thanks for the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Decision criteria you called out: data residency + auditability, per-token cost within target, predictable latency for synchronous features.
- Stakeholders we identified on the call: Samir (security), Priya (procurement), Alex (product/econ buyer). Please confirm if that list is complete.
- Security evidence: we can provide SOC 2 Type II, recent pen test summary, and a sample of audit logs/retention policy. I can share these as attachments or via a secure drive link — what do you prefer?
- Procurement & timeline: if procurement wants a standard SOW + PO, we can aim for draft by next week. Any gating items on your side?

Action items
- Alex: confirm who the economic buyer is and proposed procurement timeline.
- Priya: share any procurement templates/contract redlines you require.
- Samir: confirm which security artifacts are highest priority and any special evidence format needed (e.g., redacted logs).

I'll assemble the evidence bundle once you confirm preferred delivery method.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Samir Patel <samir@quantix.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@quantix.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya@quantix.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-demo recap & next steps

Thanks Ben — useful recap. Confirming the stakeholder map:

- Security: Samir Patel (me) — will own security review and run technical validation.
- Legal/Privacy: contracting with legal; they will triage SOC 2 and data processing terms.
- Procurement: Priya Sharma — will drive PO and commercial terms.
- Economic buyer: Alex Johnson (VP Product) — final sign-off on budget.

For security artifacts, priority order:
1) SOC 2 Type II (full report if possible; redacted OK)
2) High-level pen test summary and remediation status
3) Sample audit logs (redacted) and retention/archival policy
4) Details on encryption at-rest/in-transit and key management (KMS/HSM)

Delivery format: secure link (Google Drive with domain restrictions) is preferred. If you can include a short README describing what each artifact contains, that would be very helpful.

Timeline: our procurement wants to collect everything by 12/08 so we can review and aim for a 12/20 procurement decision. If you can get artifacts over this week, that would keep us on track.

—Samir

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@quantix.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@quantix.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya@quantix.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-demo recap & next steps

Appreciate the clarity, Samir — that's exactly what we'll provide. Attaching the initial evidence bundle (attachments are redacted stubs in this thread; full files uploaded to shared Drive link below):

Attachments:
- Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf (redacted)
- pen_test_summary_2026.pdf (summary + remediation status)
- audit_logs_sample_2026.csv (sanitized sample)

Shared folder (access set to Quantix domain): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/quantix-security
README.txt (brief):
- SOC2 report: scope = infrastructure + platform; period = 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30; redactions are in vendor details and IP addresses.
- Pen test summary: scope = core inference runtime + console; critical/high findings addressed in Q2/Q3 2026.
- Audit logs sample: contains event timestamps, user ids (hashed), and operation types; retention policy = 365 days default, option for longer retention on Dedicated/Private deployments.

Procurement notes:
- Standard MSA + SOW preferred. If Priya can share a template or specific clauses (e.g., data residency addendum), we can work in parallel with legal.
- For PO timing, Ben (me) will track and coordinate with our finance operations; we typically need 2-3 business days to countersign after terms are agreed.

Neha/Marissa — can you please confirm uploads and add a short cover note for Samir calling out the redaction approach? Priya/Alex — let us know if the Drive link access or file format needs to change.

Thanks,
Ben
--
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf (stub), pen_test_summary_2026.pdf (stub), audit_logs_sample_2026.csv (stub)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@quantix.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya@quantix.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@quantix.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T08:51:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-demo recap & next steps

Thanks Ben — received and looks good on first pass. A few quick clarifications: 

- Audit logs: can you confirm retention is configurable per customer and whether export is available via API? We may want an automated export for compliance.
- Pen test: is there an embargo period or NDAs we need to sign to view full report? The summary is helpful but legal may request full documentation.
- Procurement timeline: Priya will start drafting PO this week; our economic review team needs final pricing and expected go-live window post-signature.

If Samir is good with the artifacts as uploaded, we can move forward with internal review and procurement will aim for the 12/20 target Ben mentioned.

Alex
VP Product, Quantix

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Quantix evidence delivery & procurement coordination (internal)

Neha, Marissa — quick internal note following the external thread: 

- I uploaded the redacted SOC2, pen test summary, and sanitized audit log sample to the Quantix folder and set domain-restricted access for quantix.ai. Confirm that link is live and share with Samir.
- Marissa: please prepare the full pen test report ready to send after we have an NDA or written request from Quantix legal (Alex indicated legal may request full doc). Include a short remediation timeline doc.
- Neha: keep an eye on the HubSpot deal QTX-4532 and update the stage to "security_review". If procurement returns redlines, we'll need a quick legal loop.

Target: have evidence bundle accepted by 12/08. Follow up with a calendar invite for a security review session next week if Samir requests a review demo.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
